commands.name: independent-evidence
argv:
from pathlib import Path
import json, hashlib
root=Path('/home/ray/developer/ai/math')
audit=root/'audits/2026-10-11-br-sd-1g-adoption-publication'
c=json.loads((audit/'CHECKS.json').read_text())
assert len(c['commands'])==35 and len(c['retained_failed_commands'])==2
for row in c['commands']+c['retained_failed_commands']:
    assert row['cwd']==str(root)
    for field in ('stdout','stderr'):
        path=root/row[field+'_path']; assert path.resolve().is_relative_to(audit.resolve())
        assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row[field+'_sha256']
    path=root/row['receipt_path']; raw=path.read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==row['receipt_sha256']
    assert all(row[key]==value for key,value in json.loads(raw).items())
assert all(row['exit_code']==row['expected_exit_code'] for row in c['commands'])
for row in c['retained_failed_commands']:
    assert row['exit_code']==1 and row['expected_exit_code']==0
    assert any(good['name']==row['superseded_by'] and good['argv']==row['argv'] and good['exit_code']==good['expected_exit_code']==0 for good in c['commands'])
for prefix in ('fresh-finite','old-primary','old-independent','mapping-degrees','adoption-adapter'):
    pair=[row for row in c['commands'] if row['name'] in (prefix+'-normal',prefix+'-seed17')]
    assert len(pair)==2 and pair[0]['stdout_sha256']==pair[1]['stdout_sha256']
negative=json.loads((audit/'logs/adoption-manifest-negative/stdout.txt').read_text())
assert negative['negative_count']==9 and negative['protected_bytes_unchanged'] is True
assert len(negative['cases'])==10 and negative['cases'][0]['exit_code']==0
assert all(row['exit_code']==row['expected_exit_code']==1 for row in negative['cases'][1:])
logger=json.loads((audit/'logs/logger-controls-final/stdout.txt').read_text())
manifest=json.loads((audit/'ADOPTION_MANIFEST.json').read_text())
assert len(manifest['documents'])==6
for row in manifest['documents']:
    path=root/row['path']; data=path.read_bytes()
    assert not path.is_symlink() and len(data)==row['size'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==row['sha256'] and path.stat().st_mode&511==row['mode']==420
print(json.dumps({'status':'final evidence independently cross-checked','root_commands':35,'expected_exit0':sum(row['exit_code']==0 for row in c['commands']),'expected_exit1':sum(row['exit_code']==1 for row in c['commands']),'retained_actual_exit1_expected0':2,'identical_normal_seed_pairs':5,'manifest_positive_exit0':1,'manifest_negative_expected_exit1':9,'approved_documents':6,'tool_hashes':{name:hashlib.sha256((audit/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ('verify.py','record_check.py','aggregate_checks.py','negative_controls.py','logger_controls.py','normative_readback.py')},'parent_status':'OPEN','actual_source_status':'not triggered','new_Lean_theorem':False,'new_unconditional_closures':0},sort_keys=True))
